caption_used: 该柱状图展示了2022年7月1日至8月26日期间全球每日新增新冠确诊病例数量与相关新闻媒体报道数量的变化趋势。蓝绿色柱状图表示当日确诊病例数，蓝色折线图表示新闻报道数量。整体来看，新闻报道数量在7月中旬达到峰值约4,200篇，随后呈现持续下降趋势；而确诊病例数在8月初出现明显高峰，单日最高超过1,200,000例。值得注意的是，两条数据序列在整个观测期间始终保持高度同步的正相关波动，未出现显著的时间滞后效应。
raw_response: DESCRIPTION: This is a bar graph showing the daily number of new COVID-19 cases and the number of related news reports from July 1 to August 26, 2022. The graph displays two data series. The x-axis represents dates, ranging from July 1, 2022, to August 26, 2022, marked at irregular intervals. The left y-axis represents the number of new cases, ranging from 0 to 1,800,000, with a scale that increases by 200,000. The right y-axis represents the number of news reports, ranging from 0 to 6,000, with increments of 1,000. The graph features cyan bars representing new cases, with values fluctuating between approximately 400,000 and 1,600,000. The blue line represents the number of news reports, ranging from approximately 1,000 to 4,200. The graph shows a peak in news reports around mid-July and a peak in new cases at the beginning of August. The two data series exhibit a synchronized and positively correlated trend throughout the observed period. There are no apparent outliers or emphasized bars in the graph. The legend indicates that the cyan bars represent "daily confirmed cases" and the blue line represents "number of COVID-19 news reports."
